items.title: UBS starts medtech coverage, favors Intuitive Surgical and Enovis
items.summary: Investing.com -- UBS initiated coverage on four U.S. medical technology companies on Monday, taking a bullish stance on robotic surgery specialist Intuitive Surgical and orthopedic products maker Enovis, while adopting a more cautious outlook on sleep apnea device manufacturer Inspire Medical Systems and a neutral view on Integra LifeSciences.

items.title: Why Are Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of medical technology company Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) jumped 5.3% in the afternoon session after the company announced a collaboration with Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders to raise patient awareness of its da Vinci robotic-assisted surgery systems. The partnership aims to increase understanding of different surgical options available to patients. Sanders, a well-known sports figure, will participate in the campaign to encourage informed conversations between patients and their doctor
